lines.text: Oh no! Where is my nose?!
Let's learn thirty body parts! Ready?
This is my head! My brain lives inside!
My hair keeps my head warm!
My forehead is above my eyes!
My eyebrows go up when I'm surprised!
My eyelashes keep dust out of my eyes!
My nose helps me smell and breathe!
Puff up your cheeks, like a balloon!
My lips can smile and blow kisses!
My teeth help me chew my food!
My tongue helps me taste and talk!
This is my chin, at the bottom of my face!
Now my whole body! Move with me!
My neck holds up my head!
My chest goes up and down when I breathe!
My tummy is where my food goes!
My arms can give big hugs!
My elbows help my arms bend!
My wrists help my hands wave!
My hands can hold and clap!
Thumbs up! Thumbs help us hold things!
I have ten fingers to wiggle!
My hips help me dance! Wiggle, wiggle!
My legs help me walk and run!
My knees help my legs bend!
My ankles help my feet move!
My feet help me stand and jump!
I have ten toes! Wiggle your toes!
Let's say them all, super fast!
Big kids! Let's learn left and right!
Raise your right hand! Wave, wave!
Now your left hand! Wave, wave!
Zoom in game! What body part is this?
Now let's look inside! X-ray vision, on!
Inside my head is my brain!
My brain helps me think, learn and remember!
Inside my chest is my heart! Thump, thump!
My heart pumps blood all around my body!
Put your hand on your chest. Can you feel it beating?
Lungs help me breathe. Breathe in... and breathe out!
When I eat, my food goes down into my stomach!
Under my skin, I have bones!
Bones make me strong. A grown-up has two hundred and six bones!
Muscles help me move, run and jump! I'm so strong!
My skin covers my whole body, like a cozy coat!
Skin keeps germs out, and feels hot and cold!
Grown-ups have thirty two teeth! Brush them every day!
Lemon is sour! Ice cream is sweet!
Teddy is soft! Cactus is spiky! Ouch!
Let's use our ears! Close your eyes...
A bell! Ding, ding! Open your eyes!
Mishu Says! Only move if I say, Mishu says!
Mishu says, give a big hug!
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!
If you're happy and you know it, stamp your feet!
If you're happy and you know it, stamp your feet!
If you're happy and you know it, shout hooray!
If you're happy and you know it, shout hooray!
Animals have special body parts too!
The elephant! Its trunk is its nose!
Who has wings and a beak?
The turtle! Its shell is its house!
Who has a long tail to swing?
Big kids quiz! Are you ready?
What pumps blood around our body?
How many bones does a grown-up have?
And I will never lose my nose again! Boop!
